data.narrative:
Noveon Magnetics is a Series C robotics and manufacturing company founded by Scott Dunn and Peter Afiuny that has raised $365M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable, all operating in robotics and manufacturing at Series B through Series D stages. Key private comps include Exotec, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, and Hadrian.

Two valuation methods were applied. The stage-progression method applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yielding $620M. The peer-median approach benchmarks Noveon against seven same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers, which trade at a median valuation of $1.6B with a range of $1.0B to $2.0B.

Triangulating these methods produces a valuation range of $527M to $1.9B, with a midpoint of $1.1B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty inherent in comparing companies across distinct funding stages and development timelines within an early-stage, capital-intensive sector. The peer-median method yields valuations at the higher end of this range, while stage-progression produces more conservative estimates. Key sensitivities include revenue trajectory, customer concentration, and realized gross margins relative to peer benchmarks.
